title: 第九章 黑心稻草人
slug: 这个文字冒险游戏绝对有毒
content_zh:
【雪后初晴的清晨，你睁开眼，面前仍旧是村庄的大门。朝阳撒下，星灵界又开始了美好而充实的一天。】
【经过一夜的休整，你感觉精力充沛，行动力又恢复了巅峰状态，当前行动力5/5，是否立即开始新一天的征程？】
游戏上线，还是在昨天村庄口的位置，行动力也恢复了满值，不过上限却只有五点。
关于行动力这个东西，游戏说明是每次遇到‘选项’和每次死亡都要消耗一点，不过根据沐游的推测，这里的‘选项’，指的应该是选择后‘会让游戏路线产生明显差异’的剧情类选项，比如昨天遇到的三岔路口，还有遇到濒死的猎人，选任何一条路，都会导致完全不同的结果。
而普通的‘确定取消’、‘是否’、‘前进停留’这类简单选项，应该并不会消耗行动力。
唯一的例外是猫头鹰商店，只要‘确认’进入商店，不管买不买东西，似乎都会固定消耗一点行动力。
总之，一天五点行动力着实是有些不经用，不知道游戏里有没有提升行动力的手段。
一边想着，沐游默默点击了‘继续旅途’。
【新的一天开始，身为愚者的你，野心勃勃的继续踏上成为大巫师的旅途。】
【你进入了安宁村的大门。】
【安宁村，顾名思义，帝国边塞一座安静祥和的小村庄，自古以来以伐木和农耕产业为主要谋生手段，在周围的村落中小有名气。不过，空气中飘荡的淡淡血腥味，让你意识到，这座村庄似乎并不像它表面看起来那样安宁……】
【是否进入村庄？】
沐游当然选择‘是’。
虽然这村庄看描述好像也不太安全，但怎么也应该比野外强吧。
【你进入了村庄，看到正对着村庄大门的花田里，竖立着一根破败的稻草人。稻草人身上披着的几块破布，和头顶脏兮兮的帽子，都在昭示着它已经很久没有人打理。】
【这具破败的稻草人也是村庄的一员，虽然它无法移动，但常年驻守路口的经历，让它知道了这个村子的很多秘密，如果你舍得支付一些寿命的话，每天都可以向它打听一个随机或指定的消息。】
沐游摸了摸下巴，看这文本介绍，这个稻草人应该是‘情报商人’之类的NPC，只要付费就可以购买情报。
沐游试着点击了‘稻草人’的文本。
【你朝稻草人走去。看到你的到来，稻草人纽扣做成的眼睛里，闪动着看到一只肥羊的光彩。它热情的朝你打招呼：“哦，一位新来的冒险者，你一定很需要帮助吧？别客气，只需要向我支付一点点寿命，你就可以询问有关这个村子的任何事情，我保证知无不言！”(每日仅限一次)】
下方弹出三个选项。

【支付一点寿命，获得一个随机情报。】
【向稻草人提问一个特定的问题，稻草人会根据问题的难度，向你额外讨要5-100点不等的寿命，如果你肯支付，他才会回答你。】
【我没有问题要问，默默离开。】
“还能提问？”
沐游看着第二个选项，有些惊讶。
这个只能点点点的文字游戏，要怎么提问问题？
难道直接语音说话吗？
沐游握着怀表，试着点击了一下第二项。
结果下方居然弹出了一个文本输入框，可以像短信一样正常输入文字和符号！
沐游惊了！
他还以为这就是个纯单机的游戏，结果眼下出现了文本输入这种功能……
这是不是意味着，以后遇到别的玩家，也可以通过输入文字在游戏中互相交流？
短暂的想法飘过，沐游急忙按动了怀表，回到了之前的选项。
他这才刚到村子，什么都还不认识，当然没有特定的问题要问。
退回到前一步，沐游又点击了第一个选项。
【你向稻草人支付了一点寿命，向他询问一个随机情报。】
【寿命-1，剩余寿命55年。】
【稻草人满意的看着你，朝你神神秘秘的说：“在这座村庄的东头，生活着一名孤独的‘打更人’，他生性孤僻，没有朋友，并且昼伏夜出，每天晚上他都会提着南瓜灯，在村子里四处打更。
以前我每晚都能见到他，偶尔会和他聊聊天，所以知道了他的很多事情，但自从一个礼拜前开始，打更人忽然消失了！之后再也没有出现过——这意味着，他很可能已经遭遇了不测。
而在星灵界的规则中，死亡之人的遗物如果无人继承的话，就会变成无主之物。所以，如果你现在能进入打更人的房子，就可以得到他的所有遗产！！”】

【稻草人眼中闪动着贪婪的光芒：“不过，打更人的房屋安装有魔法结界，必须用特定的方法才能付50年寿命，我就可以告诉你开锁的方法！】
【稻草人向你讨要50年寿命，作为获得打更人遗产的代价，是否立即支付？】
下方弹出选项：【是】、【否】。
沐游心说这是什么黑心稻草人。
难怪只要一点寿命就告诉了他一个看起来挺劲爆的消息，原来关键都在第二步啊！
打更人的遗产，这个东西如果真能得到，当然很值钱，然而光知道这个消息根本没用，没有开门密码，还是无法获得遗产。
而想要获得开门方法，又需要额外支付五十年寿命，这一下，就把这个消息的价值无限拉低了。
这打更人的遗产加起来值不值五十年还不好说呢，万一
换了一般人来，这个选项都是不太值得的。
——但谁让他有怀表呢！
沐游表示他最喜欢的就是这种情报类的选项了。
“支付。”
沐游果断选择支付。
【你选择了接受稻草人的蛊惑，向它支付了五十年寿命。】
【稻草人感受着体内充盈的生命力，兴奋不已，终于向你诉说了开锁的方法……】
content_en:
[On a clear morning after the snow, you open your eyes, and you still see the village gate in front of you. As the morning sun sets, another beautiful and fulfilling day begins in the Star Spirit World. 】
[After a night's rest, you feel energetic and your mobility has returned to its peak state. Your current mobility is 5/5. Do you want to start a new day's journey immediately? 】
When the game was launched, it was still at the entrance to the village yesterday, and the mobility was restored to full value, but the upper limit was only five points.
As for mobility, the game description states that every time you encounter an 'option' and every time you die, it will consume a point. However, according to Mu You's speculation, the 'option' here should refer to plot options that will 'make a significant difference in the game route' after selection. For example, the three-way intersection encountered yesterday, and the encounter with a dying hunter. Choosing any path will lead to completely different results.
Ordinary simple options such as 'OK to Cancel', 'Whether', and 'Go and Stay' should not consume mobility.
The only exception is the Owl Store. As long as you 'confirm' to enter the store, whether you buy something or not, it seems that it will consume a certain amount of action energy.
In short, five points of mobility a day is really useless. I wonder if there is any way to improve mobility in the game.
While thinking about it, Mu You silently clicked 'Continue Journey'.
[At the beginning of a new day, as a fool, you continue to embark on the journey to become a great wizard with great ambition. 】
[You have entered the gate of Anning Village. 】
[Anning Village, as the name suggests, is a quiet and peaceful small village on the imperial frontier. Since ancient times, it has relied on logging and farming industries as its main means of livelihood, and is somewhat famous in the surrounding villages. However, the faint smell of blood floating in the air makes you realize that this village does not seem to be as peaceful as it appears...]
【Do you want to enter the village? 】
Of course Mu You chose ‘yes’.
Although this village doesn't seem very safe from the description, it should be better than the wild after all.
[You enter the village and see a dilapidated scarecrow standing in the flower field opposite the village gate. The few rags on the scarecrow's body and the dirty hat on its head all indicate that it has not been taken care of for a long time. 】
[This dilapidated scarecrow is also a member of the village. Although it cannot move, its experience of being stationed at the intersection all year round allows it to know many secrets of this village. If you are willing to pay some lifespan, you can ask it for a random or designated message every day. 】
Mu You touched his chin and looked at the text introduction. This scarecrow should be an NPC like an 'intelligence merchant'. You can buy information by paying a fee.
Mu You tried clicking on the text of 'Scarecrow'.
[You walk towards the scarecrow. Seeing you coming, the eyes made of the scarecrow's buttons flashed with the light of seeing a fat sheep. It greets you enthusiastically: "Oh, a new adventurer, you must be in need of help, right? You're welcome, you only need to pay me a little lifespan, and you can ask anything about this village, and I promise to tell you everything!" (Limited to once a day)]
Three options pop up below.
[Pay a lifespan and get a random information. 】
[Ask the Scarecrow a specific question, and the Scarecrow will ask you for an additional life span ranging from 5 to 100 points depending on the difficulty of the question. He will only answer you if you are willing to pay. 】
[I have no questions to ask and leave silently. 】
"Can I still ask questions?"
Mu You looked at the second option and was a little surprised.
How do you ask questions in this word game that can only point and click?
Is it possible to speak directly by voice?
Mu You held the pocket watch and tried clicking on the second item.
As a result, a text input box pops up below, and you can enter text and symbols normally like a text message!
Mu You was shocked!
He thought this was a purely stand-alone game, as a result, there is now a text input function...
Does this mean that when you meet other players in the future, you can also communicate with each other in the game by entering text?
After a brief thought, Mu You hurriedly pressed his pocket watch and returned to the previous options.
He had just arrived in the village, didn't know anything yet, and of course had no specific questions to ask.
Going back to the previous step, Muyou clicked on the first option again.
[You pay the scarecrow a little lifespan and ask him for random information. 】
[Lifespan -1, remaining lifespan is 55 years. 】
[The scarecrow looks at you with satisfaction and says to you mysteriously: "In the east end of this village, there lives a lonely 'watchman'. He is withdrawn by nature, has no friends, and stays out at night. Every night he will carry a jack-o'lantern and go around the village to watch."
I used to see him every night and chat with him occasionally, so I knew a lot about him. But since a week ago, the night watcher suddenly disappeared! He was never seen again - which means that something bad might have happened to him.
According to the rules of the Star Spirit World, if no one inherits the relics of a deceased person, they will become ownerless. So, if you can get into the watchman's house now, you can get all of his inheritance! ! ”]
[The scarecrow's eyes flashed with greed: "However, the watchman's house is equipped with a magic barrier, and a specific method must be used to live for 50 years. I can tell you how to unlock it!"
[The Scarecrow asks you for 50 years of life. As the price for obtaining the Scarecrow's inheritance, do you want to pay it immediately? 】
Options pop up below: [Yes], [No].
Mu Youxin said this was some kind of black-hearted scarecrow.
No wonder it only took a little lifespan to tell him what seemed to be quite exciting news. It turned out that the key lies in the second step!
The watchman's inheritance, if this thing can be obtained, is of course very valuable. However, just knowing this information is useless. Without the password to open the door, it is still impossible to obtain the inheritance.
And if you want to get the method to open the door, you need to pay an additional fifty years of life, which reduces the value of this news infinitely.
It’s hard to say whether the legacy of the watchman is worth fifty years in total. What if?
For ordinary people, this option is not worth it.
——But who let him have a pocket watch!
Mu You said that this intelligence option is his favorite.
"Pay. "
Muyou decisively chose to pay.
[You chose to accept the scarecrow’s bewitchment and paid it fifty years of life. 】
[The scarecrow feels the full vitality in his body and is very excited. He finally tells you how to unlock the lock...]
